LOCATION: An old concrete stairwell in Seoul during a thunderstorm. Wet steps, dripping rainwater, flickering red emergency lights, cold blue reflections, and vibrating metal railings.

STATIC EFFECT: Thin white-blue sparks briefly appear around Seo-Yun’s fingers, hair, clothes, and shoes during sudden movement or impact. No magic, energy beams, or teleportation.

TIME EFFECT: Normal speed, followed by a 0.25-second slow-motion impact, then an instant return to normal speed.

00–04 — CORNERED

Seo-Yun climbs the wet stairs carrying a small paper bag. Six men block her path. The leader knocks the bag down and crushes the food under his shoe.

LEADER: “고개 숙여.”

Seo-Yun looks at the ruined food and lowers her eyes.

SEO-YUN: “그만해…”

He shoves her against the railing. She catches herself, trembling.

04–08 — AWAKENING

The leader punches toward her face. The blow clips her cheek, sending her against the wall. She touches her cheek and looks at her shaking fingers.

Her fear changes to disbelief. Tiny blue-white sparks appear on her sleeve.

SEO-YUN: “왜 자꾸…”

She ducks his next punch, redirects his arm, and hits his body with a powerful short punch. A brief static crackle sounds.

08–13 — STAIRWELL BURST

Three men rush down the stairs. Seo-Yun suddenly accelerates across the landing. She dodges a hook, blocks an arm, sweeps one attacker’s legs, and kicks another.

One hits the railing, another slides onto the lower landing, and the third stumbles against the wall. Water sprays as the camera quickly follows her movement.

13–18 — VERTICAL FIGHT

The remaining attackers charge from above. Seo-Yun avoids a grab, redirects an arm, strikes with her elbow, and follows with a turning roundhouse kick.

Her shoes grip the wet concrete. A brief slow-motion impact shows moving hair, compressed clothing, and sparks at contact. The railing shakes, and dust falls from the ceiling.

18–23 — THE LAST TWO

Two men approach together. Seo-Yun charges between them, dodges a punch, strikes one in the body, and spins into a back kick.

Both attackers fall realistically against the landing and wall.

Time snaps back to normal. Seo-Yun lands with bent knees, breathing heavily. She looks up at the leader.

23–27 — FINAL FIGHT

The leader charges down the stairs and throws a wide hook. Seo-Yun dodges, blocks his next strike, moves around his shoulder, and lands a short punch followed by a turning kick.

A 0.25-second slow-motion shot captures the kick hitting his torso, water spraying, and tiny sparks flashing at the impact.

He stumbles and collapses against the wall.

27–30 — THE EXIT

The sparks fade. The emergency lights stop flickering, but rainwater continues dripping.

Seo-Yun looks at the fading sparks between her fingers, frightened and confused.

SEO-YUN: “내 몸이… 왜 이래?”

She picks up the ruined paper bag, looks at it sadly, and walks up the final stairs into the rainy night.

CUT TO BLACK.

CAMERA AND SOUND

Use handheld tracking, low-angle full-body shots, close-ups of her eyes, wide stairwell shots, realistic focus changes, and natural motion blur. The camera briefly struggles to keep up during speed bursts.

Sound includes Korean dialogue, rain, dripping water, footsteps, breathing, clothing movement, metal vibrations, body impacts, and subtle static crackles.

No background music, subtitles, or narration.

REALISM RULES

One consistent Seo-Yun identity. Realistic human anatomy, foot placement, balance, momentum, wet-surface traction, and gravity. Water reacts naturally to movement. No floating bodies, duplicate people, gore, impossible movements, or sudden location changes.

NEGATIVE PROMPT: No anime, cartoon effects, artificial-looking characters, magic, energy beams, supernatural shockwaves, teleportation, exaggerated slow motion, or unrealistic physics.

She wears a fitted pastel-blue short top, loose cream pajama-style pants, black sneakers, and a simple silver necklace. Maintain consistent facial identity, outfit, and body proportions throughout.

**STORY:**

She wakes up from an evening nap in her modest Seoul apartment, looking sleepy and confused. She sits on the bed, rubs her eyes, stretches lazily, and checks the time on an old bedside clock. Her messy ponytail is half undone, and she yawns at the camera before saying, “Wait… is it evening already?”

She slips on her sneakers, grabs a little shopping bag, and leaves the apartment. The camera follows her down the stairs and through a narrow residential street filled with parked bicycles, overhead wires, small shops, and warm evening sunlight.

She visits a tiny neighborhood convenience shop, picks up potato chips, chocolate, instant noodles, and a bottled drink, then examines a snack packet suspiciously before laughing at the camera. She pays at the counter and walks outside with her purchases.

Feeling thirsty, she stops at an outdoor public water tap beside a small neighborhood park. She unties her ponytail, lets her long black hair fall naturally around her shoulders, splashes a little water onto her face, and drinks directly from the running tap with her hands cupped beneath it. Water drips from her fingers, and she laughs when a little splashes onto her top. She wipes her face with her hand and shakes her loose hair back casually.

She sits on a low concrete wall beneath the trees, opens her chips, takes a crunchy bite, and watches children playing and neighbors walking past. She offers a snack toward the camera as if sharing it with her friend filming.

Finally, she walks back home along the quiet street, carrying her snacks. At the apartment entrance, she turns toward the camera with a sleepy but happy smile and says, “Okay, now I'm ready for the evening!” The footage ends abruptly as her friend laughs and the camera tilts toward the ground.

No polished cinematography or smooth tracking shots.

**SETTING:** A modest Seoul apartment and an older Korean residential neighborhood circa 2003, narrow lanes, small convenience shops, public outdoor water taps, concrete walls, bicycles, overhead wires, and leafy neighborhood corners.

**AUDIO:** Natural evening ambience, birds, distant scooters, footsteps, shop door chime, snack packaging, coins, running water, splashing, crunching chips, neighborhood chatter, and spontaneous laughter. Casual natural English dialogue. No background music or narration.

**REALISM & CONTINUITY:** Natural sleepy expressions, believable hand movements, realistic water flow and splashes, consistent clothing and accessories, and a single continuous character identity. Her ponytail is untied only when she stops at the water tap and remains loose afterward. The video must feel like a forgotten personal recording from 2003, not a staged production.

CAMERA RULE: dynamic shoulder-mounted handheld with real weight and micro-shake, mixed with occasional low floating glides on the wet floor and a few whip pans. The operator stays close to the action and is never perfectly stable.

She wears her oversized lavender varsity jacket with cream striped trims and a cream “B” patch over a black tank, light-wash wide-leg jeans (hems soaked and darker), and chunky black sneakers. Her sword blade is a solid beam of cold silver-white light with a soft pale sapphire edge, reflected in the water under her feet.

CHARACTER B (use Image B as reference): a real young woman in her early 20s with fair skin, a beauty mark on her cheek, very long straight jet-black hair with wispy bangs, silver hoop earrings and a thin silver necklace. She wears her black satin bomber jacket over a white crop tank, washed-black cargo pants and white chunky sneakers that get muddier through the fight. Her sword blade is a solid beam of deep burnt-copper and ember-amber light, casting warm reflections on the wet stone.

PHYSICS RULE: every step, slide and landing throws sheets of water. Droplets catch the blade light. Where a blade touches the surface it leaves a brief glowing wake and hissing steam.

CHOREOGRAPHY RULE: no long pauses. Each exchange ends in a 2-3 frame freeze pose (back-turned stance with the blade pointing behind, low crouch with the blade skimming the water, one-handed overhead guard, mid-air spin).

TIMELINE

0.0-3.0s | LOW GLIDE THROUGH THE MIST. 35mm, camera 40 cm above the water, gliding slowly forward past a stone lantern. Rain taps the puddles. Sound: rain, distant bell tone, rising electric hum.

セリフ、ナレーション、歌、字幕、背景音楽なし。

アイコンから出る瞬間に小さな紙の「ふわっ」という音。

音は必ず画面内の動作と同期させる。

女の子は円形アイコンへ戻り、分身は存在しない。

悬崖之巅的古中式寺院演武场。青灰石板平台悬于千仞绝壁之上，正后方是双层瓦顶木构正殿与宽石阶，殿前立着数根木构廊柱；侧后方立着那块被击穿的青灰色巨岩；两侧是低矮石栏；崖边生着古松；三面临深渊，白色云海在崖下翻涌。

【刚性空间锚点】正殿、宽石阶、被击穿的巨岩、崖边古松、远处群峰，全片位置绝不漂移、消失或改变数量。

【围观】八名学生围成半圆站在演武场边缘，master 站在正中，双手负在身后。全程站在圈外，绝不进场、绝不被打到。

【这是一场凶狠的恶战·必须严格遵守】

这不是点到为止的表演，不是一方进攻一方化解。从第 1 秒起双方都在往死里打：每一拳都打实、每一脚都蹬实、每一次撞击都有真实的冲击反馈。

cat 是重炮：震脚、掌根轰击、肩靠冲撞、双爪下砸、整个身体压上去。他每一击都带着整个体重，打空的每一击都会砸碎身后的东西。

hamster 是连射：铲、撞、蹬、踢、攀、扑，频率是 cat 的两倍。他打中的每一下都让 cat 的身体真实地晃动、后滑、踉跄。

两人互相命中。cat 被打中会后滑、踉跄、单膝一沉；hamster 被打中会横飞出去、撞上石栏、在地上滚出好几米——然后立刻弹起来冲回去。

绝不允许任何一方站着不动、只防守、背手、等待、蓄力、摆姿势。两人始终在移动、始终在出手。

【伤害等级 0】全片无血、无伤口、无淤青、无骨折。双方不攻击对方的面部。凶狠只体现为：击中身体时毛发与衣物被打得炸开、汗水被震成雾、被打飞撞墙、在地上犁出长沟、呼吸剧烈、重心被打散。

【无色冲击特效】所有力量只通过空气与物理表现，不使用彩色能量。普通击中：局部空气闪动、尘粒震散、毛发炸开。重击：拳头大小的透明冲击环从接触点扩散，推动尘土与碎石。冲击环必须从真实接触点产生并迅速衰减。

【环境破坏·逐步升级、永久保持】
石板炸裂 → 石栏被撞碎 → 廊柱被打出裂口 → 一根廊柱被撞断、屋檐下沉、瓦片成片滑落 → 石阶被踏碎 → 古松枝干折断 → 地面石板成片掀起。被击穿的巨岩不得被再次破坏。已损坏处永久保持。

【胜负】cat 赢。13—22 秒必须让人以为 hamster 要赢了。hamster 输得体面，不狼狈、不求饶、不哭。

【密度】1—22 秒之间每秒 6—8 次清晰的攻防状态变化，双方动作互相咬合，没有任何间隙。速度快至巅峰，但不是快进，不用模糊残影掩盖动作——每一击都有支撑脚、腰胯发力、重心交换与惯性收势。

【速度坡道】只允许出现在四个瞬间：5 秒掌根砸地、11 秒廊柱断裂、13 秒踩头、22 秒最后一推。其余全部正常速度。

【对白规则】本片没有任何台词、对白、旁白或内心独白。所有文字都是画面说明，绝对不得念出、不得配音。

声音：沉重的肉垫踏地、拳掌击中身体的闷响、短促的音爆、石板炸裂、木柱断裂、瓦片哗啦滑落、急促的呼吸、围观学生的惊呼、崖风。

【运镜】全程一镜到底，绝不硬切、剪辑或定格。24mm 超广角，FPV 穿越机流动感结合手持冲击，1.5Hz 呼吸微抖，0.08 秒惯性延迟。贴地低机位跟随 hamster，仰拍跟随 cat，两人同框时拉开让体型差入画。大量使用 Whip Pan、贴身环绕、撞击时先锁定接触点再被冲击推开。每当 hamster 落地停顿，镜头让他的圆脸与圆耳朵清晰入画至少半秒。镜头只穿过真实空隙。

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

【0.0—1.0 秒｜礼】

两人面对面相距四步，同时抱拳——cat 齐眉躬身，hamster 躬得几乎折成一半。礼未收尽，两人同时蹬地，脚下石板各炸开一圈裂纹。

运镜：低机位平推，起步瞬间沿轴线急速后撤。

【1.0—3.0 秒｜正面对撞】

两人在场中央正面撞上。cat 一记震脚掌根轰下，hamster 贴地滑铲钻过，掌根砸碎他身后的石板；hamster 起身一记头槌撞进 cat 的肚子，cat 被顶得后滑半步，反手一爪横扫，hamster 被扫得横飞出去，撞上石栏，石栏炸开一个缺口——他落地翻滚两圈，弹起来又冲了回来。

运镜：贴地跟随滑铲，撞栏时被冲击后震，随即 Whip Pan 跟随他冲回。

【3.0—5.0 秒｜连射】

hamster 一口气打出六下：铲脚踝、撞膝、蹬胯、攀腰、踢肋、蹬肩弹开——每一下都打实，cat 的身体被打得连晃三次，橘毛一片片炸开。cat 硬吃下来，沉胯一记肩靠撞出，hamster 被撞得倒飞，在石板上犁出一道长长的沟，碎石飞溅。

运镜：贴身极小半径环绕跟随六连击，肩靠命中瞬间稳定锁定接触点并被冲击推开。

【5.0—7.0 秒｜重炮】

cat 追上去，双爪高举，整个身体压下来一记下砸。

【速度坡道】hamster 侧滚让开，双爪砸中石板的瞬间明显减速：石板炸成蛛网裂纹，一圈透明冲击环贴地扩散，碎石与尘土被掀起半人高，围观学生的衣角被气浪吹起。随后立刻恢复正常速度。

hamster 从尘幕中弹出，一记飞蹬正中 cat 的胸口，cat 后退两步。

运镜：随下砸急速下降至地面，冲击环扩散时被推开，随即抬升跟随飞蹬。

【7.0—9.0 秒｜廊柱区】

两人边打边冲进廊柱区。cat 连续三记掌根推出，hamster 绕柱闪避，掌根全部轰在廊柱上，木柱被打出三道裂口，木屑炸飞；hamster 蹬柱反弹，从 cat 的头顶上方掠过，反身一记双脚蹬背，cat 被蹬得往前扑撞上另一根廊柱，整根木柱剧烈震颤，屋檐上的瓦片哗啦啦滑落一片。

运镜：Whip Pan 跟随绕柱追击，瓦片滑落时镜头急速抬升。

【9.0—11.0 秒｜抓与甩】

hamster 冲上来抓住 cat 的麻绳腰带，整个人挂在侧面连踢肋部；cat 一把揪住他的布褂后领，抡起来整个甩了出去——hamster 在空中翻正，双脚蹬上正殿的石阶立面，踏碎一级台阶，借力像炮弹一样反冲回来。

运镜：随甩出的轨迹急速横移，蹬碎台阶时稳定锁定，随后随反冲急速倒飞。

【11.0—13.0 秒｜断柱】

hamster 一头撞进 cat 的胸口，cat 被撞得倒退，后背重重砸上那根已经开裂的廊柱。

【速度坡道】撞击瞬间明显减速：木柱从裂口处折断，断口爆出木纤维与木屑，屋檐的一角随之下沉倾斜，整排瓦片从檐口成片滑落砸碎在石板上。随后立刻恢复正常速度。

cat 从断木与落瓦中冲出，满身木屑，一记大幅度双爪扑击压向 hamster——这是他到目前为止最狠的一击。

运镜：撞柱时锁定接触点后被推开，随后拉远呈现屋檐下沉与瓦片坠落。

【13.0—14.5 秒｜踩头】

hamster 没有躲。他在接触前一瞬蹲下，双爪抓住 cat 压下来的手腕，借着他的下压之力整个人翻上去——顺着手臂、肩膀攀到头顶。

【速度坡道】他在 cat 的头顶狠狠踏下一脚弹射出去的瞬间明显减速：cat 的脑袋被踩得往下一沉，脚下石板炸开，重心彻底打散。随后立刻恢复正常速度。

cat 踉跄着连退三步，抬起头——那双金色瞳孔第一次完全睁开。外围爆出一片抽气声。

运镜：随攀爬急速抬升，踩头瞬间稳定锁定，随即急速下降跟随踉跄。

【14.5—19.0 秒｜小家伙要赢了】

hamster 彻底打疯了。他像一颗在 cat 身上四处弹射的浅棕灰色毛球：铲、撞、蹬、踢、攀、扑、滚，每秒七八下，每一下都打实。cat 也在全力还击——掌根、肩靠、下砸、横扫——但目标太小太快，每一击都慢了半拍，全部砸在了身后：石栏被扫碎、古松的枝干被一爪劈断、地面石板被震得一块块翘起。

cat 开始真正吃亏：铲中脚踝单膝一沉、蹬中肩膀身体一晃、从背后一撞往前踉跄、腰带被扯松垂下、胸口剧烈起伏。他被一步一步打退到演武场边缘，脚后跟踩上了最后一块石板的边缘。

外围的学生们彻底沸腾——tiger 跳起来大喊，panda 拍着爪子，rabbit 蹦起来，连 panther 都站直了。他们在为那个小东西喝彩。

运镜：贴身极小半径环绕，Whip Pan 跟随高速换位，穿插 cat 后退的脚部特写与落空的重击砸碎环境的瞬间。

【19.0—22.0 秒｜最后一冲】

hamster 蹬上那块被击穿的巨岩，借力反弹，像一颗圆滚滚的炮弹直冲 cat 而来——这是他今天最快、最狠的一击。

cat 的呼吸还是乱的，但他的眼神稳住了。他打了二十秒，他知道：hamster 每一次从高处扑下，落地那一刻都会把重心全部压在右脚上——因为他太小，必须那样才能稳住。

运镜：随反弹轨迹急速抬升，随后急速下降至 cat 的面部特写。

【22.0—24.0 秒｜一招】

以下三步必须严格按先后顺序发生，绝对不得同时发生：

第一步：cat 侧身让开，炮弹从他身侧擦过，什么都没打到。

第二步：hamster 落地，右脚先着地，重心全部压了上去。

第三步：【速度坡道】cat 的掌根已经在那里了，按上 hamster 的肩头顺着他落地的方向一推——他的右脚被自己的重心锁死，整个圆球形的身体仰倒下去，背部平平砸在石板上，一圈透明冲击环从他身下扩散，尘土被掀起。随后恢复正常速度。

cat 的爪子停在他胸口上方三寸处，没有落下去。

全场安静了。master 的眼睛极轻微地眯了一下——那是他教过的东西。

运镜：侧身时跟随擦过的轨迹；落地瞬间急速降至石板高度；推倒的动作完整入画，背部着地瞬间稳定锁定，随后缓缓上摇至悬停的爪子。

【24.0—27.0 秒｜扶起】

hamster 仰面躺着，圆滚滚的肚子剧烈起伏，乌黑的小圆眼睛瞪着那只悬停的爪子，眉头还拧着——不服气，但他知道结束了。

cat 收回爪子，然后伸了出去。hamster 盯着那只大爪子看了两秒，用小粉爪抓住了它。cat 一把把他拉起来，轻得像拎一个布袋。hamster 拍掉身上的灰，扯正布褂；cat 把松掉的腰带系紧。

运镜：地面角度仰拍伸来的爪子，握住瞬间锁定两只大小悬殊的爪子，拉起时随之抬升。

【27.0—30.0 秒｜敬意】

两人抱拳行礼。hamster 躬得比开场时更深，久久不起。cat 也躬身，躬得比开场时更低；起身后看着他停了一秒，极轻微地点了一下头。

hamster 愣住了，小圆眼睛慢慢睁大，圆耳朵往前竖起来，然后把拳头握得更紧。

外围的学生爆发出掌声，这一次是给两个人的。master 双手仍负在身后，面部几乎没有变化，只有眼角浮起一丝极淡的笑意，视线从 hamster 移到 cat 身上，停住。

最后一帧：满地狼藉的演武场中央——碎裂翘起的石板、被撞碎的石栏、折断的廊柱、下沉的屋檐、满地碎瓦与断枝——一大一小两个身影相对而立，都还在喘；外围是鼓掌的学生与 master；背后是被击穿的巨岩与翻涌的云海。画面自然收束。

运镜：行礼时低机位仰拍，最后缓慢后拉至广角，不定格、不摆造型——尘土还在落，崖风还在吹。

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

【全局约束】

masterpiece, highest quality。全片 11 个角色：master、cat、hamster 与八名学生，每个只出现一次，绝不复制、绝不多出第十二个。没有小熊猫。

所有角色外貌、毛色、体型、服装全程一致。hamster 全程是圆球形、圆耳朵、平脸、无尾巴的仓鼠。

cat 从第 1 秒起全力进攻，全片绝不站着不动、绝不只防守、绝不背手。两人在 1—22 秒之间始终在移动、始终在出手、互相命中。

cat 最后获胜；hamster 在 22 秒被放倒后不再进攻，全程不狼狈、不求饶、不哭。

破坏只能单向累积，必须由实际接触触发。被击穿的巨岩不得被再次破坏。八名学生全程站在圈外。

【负面提示词】

仓鼠变成小熊猫，出现小熊猫，仓鼠长出蓬松大尾巴，仓鼠长出环纹尾巴，仓鼠长出尖耳朵，仓鼠长出长口鼻，仓鼠脸上出现白色面罩，仓鼠变成红棕色，仓鼠变成浣熊、狐狸、老鼠或松鼠，仓鼠轮廓改变；

节奏缓慢，慢热，温吞，点到为止，表演性对练，一方进攻一方化解，cat 站着不动，cat 只防守，cat 背手，cat 双脚不动，原地对峙，打斗只在一个位置，攻击没有打实，击中没有反馈，被击中没有后退，动作之间有停顿，互相等待，轮流出招，蓄力，摆 pose；

hamster 获胜，cat 落败，平局，没有胜负，hamster 在 22 秒后继续进攻，hamster 哭，求饶，狼狈逃跑，搞笑式失败；

攻击面部，打脸，流血，伤口，淤青，骨折，兵器，彩色能量，发光特效，气功光效，火焰，雷电，游戏 UI，廉价粒子，冲击环脱离接触点，无来源破坏，破坏早于命中；

巨岩被再次击穿，正殿整体倒塌，平台崩塌，破坏复原，石板复原，廊柱复原；

学生人数不是八个，多出第十二个角色，角色复制，分身，围观者进场，围观者被打到；

体型差消失，hamster 变高，cat 变矮，两者等高，角色四足着地，爪子变成人手，卡通渲染，Q版，动漫风格；

角色三视图，灰白摄影棚背景，细节格，色卡条，FRONT VIEW 字样，图片原有文字，台词，对白，旁白，字幕，水印；

全片慢动作，定格帧，快进感，跳帧加速，动作没有重量，布偶飞行，硬切，多机位剪辑，黑屏转场，镜头瞬移，过量滚转，人物出画，低清晰度，卡顿，过曝。

prompt:
Create a live-action cinematic revenge-comedy video set inside a crowded Seoul shopping mall. Use realistic handheld camera movement, bright mall lighting, natural crowd ambience, exaggerated but believable slapstick physics, and spontaneous reactions.

CHARACTERS: A confident Korean woman in her 20s with long black wavy hair, wearing a fitted black crop top, blue jeans, white sneakers, and a stylish shoulder bag. A cocky Korean man in his 20s wears a dark oversized hoodie, loose jeans, and white sneakers. Maintain consistent faces, outfits, and body proportions throughout.

STORY:

The woman stands near a shopping mall escalator, holding several shopping bags and checking her phone. The man deliberately bumps into her, grabs one of her bags, and jokingly tosses it onto a nearby bench. He smirks and says, “Watch where you're standing.” She calmly retrieves her bag, looks at him, and replies, “Oh, you want to play?”

As he walks away confidently, she notices his untied shoelace and calls out, “Hey, your shoe!” He turns back just as she nudges an empty rolling shopping basket toward him. He steps backward, trips over his own loose lace, and lands comically inside a giant promotional display filled with oversized stuffed animals. Plush toys bounce everywhere as nearby shoppers turn around in shock.

Embarrassed, he jumps up and tries to act tough, but accidentally steps onto a small rolling display platform. It glides across the polished floor, carrying him past several storefronts while he desperately tries to stop himself. He bumps harmlessly into a tower of empty cardboard boxes, which collapses around him in a spectacular but soft, harmless mess.

The woman walks over, calmly hands him his fallen phone, and says, “Next time, try being respectful.” He looks around at the laughing bystanders, grabs his belongings, and hurriedly walks away. She adjusts her shoulder bag, flashes a confident smile toward the camera, and strolls off as the recording ends with the friend filming laughing.

Maintain a traceable transformation chain: stone stair edges become road lanes, traffic trails become sideways rain, umbrella ribs become banyan roots. Gravity rotates with folded surfaces, but each step lands on a visible solid path. No portals, unexplained teleportation, physical collisions or injured animals.

Begin with a high three-quarter 35mm wide shot of the staircase from reference two, its glowing steps crossing deep shadows diagonally. Hundreds of commuters flow as semi-transparent black smears. Only one man stands perfectly crisp in a pool of light. A tiny bird waits one step ahead, surrounded by ghostly shoes. Plunge to an urgent foot-level 85mm close-up. He crouches and gently shelters the bird between his hands. One wing flickers. Crowds bend around his motionless body like water around a stone. This small decision visibly disturbs the city’s flow.
00:02.6-00:05.5 | THE ROAD THAT CLIMBS THE SKY
Whip around his shoulder as the horizon rolls ninety degrees clockwise. Stair edges unspool like photographic film and stretch into wet highway lanes. The commuter streaks become speeding cars, echoing reference three. Asphalt folds vertically against a massive facade. Cradling the bird, he runs three steps along a broad solid ledge, coat swinging toward the new gravity. Swing an 18mm camera beneath his feet: entire lanes of vehicles roar overhead, drawing thin white lines through the dark, without striking him. Road spray shoots sideways and hangs in the air. 00:05.5-00:09.2 | SHE HOLDS THE UMBRELLA

00:09.2-00:12.3 | ROOTS OF THE RAIN
Orbit close around the umbrella’s clear ribs. They extend into silver rain strands, then thicken into the hanging aerial roots of the immense banyan. Its translucent dome transforms continuously into the tree’s black canopy. Pull back through roots and mist to reveal reference four: a giant riverside tree, humble metal tea table, elderly seller and luminous long-exposure river. The man steps onto solid soil and opens his hands; the bird hops safely onto the table. The seller silently sets out a second cup and pours. Cut in close to the stream, its tiny ripple and delicate steam. The traffic roar recedes. Ordinary hospitality suddenly feels more miraculous than the folding city.
00:12.3-00:15.0 | THE IMPOSSIBLE REVEAL
Crane backward from the tea cup into an extraordinary master wide shot without a sudden cut. The banyan, both men and the bird occupy the only still part of the world. Around them the four environments now physically coexist: the rainy shelter curves into the vertical highway, the road spirals into the monumental staircase, and crowds, cars and rain orbit like a cyclone of black-and-white long-exposure photographs. Even the silver river mirrors the traffic trails. No explosions or glowing portals, just undeniable impossible geometry. In the foreground the seller slides a cup to the young man, who accepts it with the hands that protected the bird. Hold the final silhouettes beneath the huge tree, encircled by a whole city in motion. Their stillness is the miracle.
CAMERA DESIGN AND SEAMLESS TRANSFORMATIONS
Stage the whole film as one seemingly unbroken tracking shot. Conceal transitions in a passing coat, vehicle streak, veil of rain and close umbrella rib. Alternate architectural wide views, an intimate close-up of protective hands, a low-angle gravity roll, a lateral rain pan, a smooth canopy orbit and the final rising master reveal. Preserve the man’s travel direction and continuous spatial geography. Transform by matching lines and arcs, never by melting everything. All feet, shadows, water, fabric and reflections must obey their current surface’s physics. Motion blur belongs to crowds and traffic, never to the faces, bird, cup or critical gestures. Every tenth of a second must advance the same cause-and-effect story.
SOUND AND EMOTIONAL FINISH
Sound begins as a subterranean city pulse of rushing shoes, punctuated by one tiny wing flutter. The rotating highway produces a sweeping tire roar that resolves into rain striking transparent umbrellas. Muffle the city for one beat when the woman shares shelter. Roots bring leaves, a distant river, ceramic against metal and a distinct tea pour. Use at most one restrained cello note, never an emotional swell. Avoid cartoon magic, bright portals, doubled people, extra limbs, facial distortions, rubbery cars, jump cuts or artificial bokeh. End with a profound visual idea, not words: modern life may rush at impossible speed, yet one quiet act of compassion makes a place where time can be felt.

DISNEY WORLD, 2001 — “THE DAY WE NEVER FORGOT”

30 SECONDS | 9:16 | PHOTOREALISTIC EARLY-2000s FAMILY VACATION HOME VIDEO | SEEDANCE 2.5 | MULTISHOT

CAMERA

The entire video is recorded by a parent using a consumer MiniDV camcorder during a family vacation to Walt Disney World’s Magic Kingdom in summer 2001. Authentic early-2000s home-video footage, imperfect handheld framing, natural camera shake, occasional autofocus hunting, slight digital zoom, exposure adjustments, soft standard-definition detail, and interlaced-video artifacts.

The camera operator is a parent documenting the day spontaneously. The camera sometimes lags behind the action, pans too far, and takes a moment to find the subject again. Every shot must look like footage recorded by the same family on the same camcorder.

No professional tracking shots, drone footage, cinematic slow motion, modern smartphone footage, or polished commercial cinematography.

CHARACTERS

Father: Early-30s American man wearing a faded navy-blue polo shirt, beige cargo shorts, white athletic sneakers, and a black camcorder wrist strap.

Mother: Early-30s American woman wearing a pale yellow short-sleeved top, denim shorts, white sneakers, and a small shoulder bag.

Son: Eight-year-old American boy with short brown hair, wearing a red T-shirt, blue denim shorts, white socks, and white sneakers. He carries a small disposable souvenir bag.

All three characters must retain exactly the same faces, ages, hairstyles, body proportions, and clothing throughout the video.

Their behaviour is spontaneous and natural. The boy is excited, curious, and occasionally distracted. The parents smile, laugh, and speak casually. No exaggerated acting or perfectly synchronized reactions.

SETTING

Walt Disney World’s Magic Kingdom, Florida, in summer 2001.

Recognizable locations include Main Street, U.S.A., Cinderella Castle, a classic theme-park attraction, and a daytime parade route. Period-appropriate park signage, costumes, architecture, merchandise, and crowd clothing.

The park is busy with families, strollers, paper maps, disposable cameras, and visitors carrying camcorders. The footage must not contain modern smartphones, contemporary electric vehicle designs, modern social-media references, or present-day digital advertising screens.

Bright summer daylight outside, warm sunlight, occasional humid haze, and natural shadows.

STORY — EXACT SHOT TIMELINE

SHOT 01 — 00:00–00:04

Purpose: Establish the vacation and reveal the castle.

Camera: Handheld wide shot from adult eye level on Main Street, U.S.A. The camcorder initially points toward passing visitors before the operator slowly pans toward Cinderella Castle.

Action: The father walks forward while recording. The boy enters the lower part of the frame, holding his mother’s hand. When the castle comes into view, he stops walking and looks upward.

The camera briefly tilts too high, cropping the castle’s upper section, then corrects downward.

Father, speaking behind the camera:
“Hey, look! Look at the castle!”

Audio: Footsteps, overlapping conversations, children shouting, distant theme-park music, and the faint hiss of the camcorder microphone.

End frame: The boy stands in the foreground looking toward the castle, his parents partially visible beside him.

SHOT 02 — 00:04–00:08

Purpose: Capture the child’s genuine reaction.

Camera: Slightly shaky medium close-up at the boy’s eye level. The father bends down to film him, creating a brief downward camera movement.

Action: The boy turns from the castle toward the lens with wide eyes and a huge natural smile. He points behind himself, then grabs his father’s free hand and tries to pull him forward.

Boy, excitedly:
“Dad! Can we go inside?”

Father, laughing:
“We’re going!”

Audio: Natural family dialogue, crowd chatter, footsteps, and faint music from the park.

End frame: The boy pulls his father’s hand and moves out of the frame toward the castle.

SHOT 03 — 00:08–00:12

Purpose: Move naturally from the entrance into the attraction experience.

Camera: Handheld footage from a seated position inside a classic dark ride, resembling an early-2000s family attraction. Slightly shaky medium shot of the boy seated between his parents.

Action: The ride vehicle moves slowly forward. The boy looks from one side to the other at colourful illuminated scenery. He laughs and briefly leans toward his mother. The father turns the camcorder slightly to keep both faces in frame.

The ride’s motion remains smooth and physically plausible. The scene does not suddenly jump to a roller coaster or another attraction.

Audio: Ride machinery, children laughing, muffled attraction music, and the boy’s spontaneous giggle.

End frame: The boy turns toward his father and laughs directly into the lens.

SHOT 04 — 00:12–00:17

Purpose: Show the energy of the park.

Camera: Handheld medium-wide shot from behind the family at the parade route. The father raises the camcorder above shoulder level, then adjusts the zoom.

Action: A colourful Disney parade passes along the street. Period-appropriate costumed performers wave to spectators while a decorated parade float moves slowly past. The boy waves enthusiastically from beside his mother.

The camera pans to follow one performer, briefly loses the subject behind a spectator’s head, then finds the boy again.

Voiceover:
“Back in 2001, a day like this meant being completely caught up in the moment.”

Audio: Parade music, clapping, children’s excited voices, and the sound of the crowd. The narration remains clear but does not drown out the real environment.

End frame: The boy is waving toward the passing parade, with his mother smiling beside him.

SHOT 05 — 00:17–00:21

Purpose: Capture an ordinary, personal vacation memory.

Camera: Handheld medium close-up outside a period-appropriate snack stand. Natural daylight, slightly uneven exposure.

Action: The mother hands the boy a Mickey-shaped frozen treat. He takes a bite, notices a little melting onto his fingers, and laughs. The father moves the camera closer, then pulls back when the boy reaches toward the lens with his sticky hand.

Mother, laughing:
“Careful! Don’t get it on the camera!”

Audio: Family laughter, paper wrapping, nearby conversations, and distant park music.

End frame: The boy grins at the camera while holding the treat carefully in both hands.

SHOT 06 — 00:21–00:26

Purpose: Transition naturally from daytime excitement to evening.

Camera: Handheld wide shot from behind the family as they walk along Main Street, U.S.A. toward Cinderella Castle.

Action: The boy walks between his parents, holding both their hands. The father briefly turns the camcorder toward the illuminated shop windows, then pans back to the family.

The sky is approaching dusk, and warm park lights begin to stand out. The transition is a chronological jump forward to later that same day, not an instantaneous change in lighting within a continuous shot.

Voiceover:
“We didn’t know which moments we’d remember. We just kept recording.”

Audio: Softer crowd chatter, footsteps, distant music, and the camcorder operator’s quiet breathing.

End frame: The family slows down with the illuminated castle in the background.

SHOT 07 — 00:26–00:30

Purpose: Deliver a nostalgic and emotionally memorable ending.

Camera: Handheld medium-wide shot, slightly tilted, with the family and castle visible. The father steadies the camcorder against his body but does not achieve perfect professional framing.

Action: The boy turns toward the camera and waves. His mother places a hand on his shoulder. The father holds the shot for a moment, then the camera slowly dips toward the pavement as if he is lowering it to stop recording.

Voiceover, warm and reflective:
“Maybe that’s why the old memories mean so much. We were there. And that was enough.”

Audio: Distant park music, gentle crowd ambience, footsteps, and natural microphone noise. No dramatic orchestral swell.

Final frame: The image tilts downward toward the pavement, briefly catching the family’s moving feet. The recording ends abruptly, like an authentic home-video tape.

LIGHTING

Natural Florida summer daylight during the daytime scenes. Warm, slightly uneven tungsten and decorative lighting in the evening. Realistic exposure shifts when moving between bright outdoor spaces and darker attractions. No cinematic rim lighting, artificial haze, or modern commercial colour grading.

HUMAN PERFORMANCE

Every character must behave like a real family on vacation. The boy reacts spontaneously, speaks casually, and changes attention naturally. The parents do not pose for the camera continuously. Background visitors walk, talk, queue, and watch the parade independently.

Avoid synchronized crowds, frozen background people, exaggerated expressions, duplicated faces, unnatural hand movements, and artificial smiles.

AUDIO

Authentic early-2000s family home-video sound. Natural family conversations, footsteps, distant music, ride sounds, crowd chatter, laughter, and subtle camcorder microphone noise.

Voiceover should sound like a warm, conversational contemporary YouTube documentary narrator reflecting on childhood memories. Keep narration separate from character dialogue. No trailer-style delivery, artificial cinematic impacts, or overpowering music.

VISUAL CHARACTER

Authentic 2001 consumer MiniDV recording. Present the footage in a 9:16 vertical canvas with the actual camcorder image framed in a 4:3 aspect ratio, preserving its original proportions without stretching faces.

Soft standard-definition resolution, mild digital noise, interlaced-video texture, occasional autofocus hunting, subtle colour bleeding, imperfect white balance, slight overexposure in bright sunlight, and naturally warm skin tones.

The result must resemble a genuine family vacation tape recovered decades later—not a modern recreation designed to look cinematic.

CONTINUITY

1. The same father, mother, and son appear throughout all seven shots.
2. Clothing, faces, hairstyles, body proportions, and accessories remain consistent.
3. The boy remains eight years old and wears the same red T-shirt and denim shorts.
4. The family moves logically through Magic Kingdom, from Main Street to an attraction, the parade route, a snack stand, and back toward the castle.
5. Daylight progresses naturally into dusk across the sequence.
6. The camcorder perspective remains that of the father recording his family.
7. Every shot begins with a clear physical position and ends with a composition that supports the next cut.
8. No teleporting, sudden wardrobe changes, duplicated family members, unexplained location changes, or contradictory movements.
9. No modern phones, social-media overlays, captions, or artificial transitions.
10. The footage must retain its candid, imperfect home-video character throughout.

FINAL INTENT

Create a believable 30-second family vacation memory from Walt Disney World’s Magic Kingdom in 2001. The viewer should feel as though they have found an old MiniDV tape documenting one ordinary but unforgettable childhood day.

The emotional power comes from spontaneous reactions, small family interactions, authentic period details, and the imperfect camera work of a parent trying to capture everything.

The final result must feel lived-in, nostalgic, intimate, and real—not a polished Disney advertisement or an AI-generated cinematic montage.

prompt:
A stylish young man is filming himself in his bedroom while getting dressed. The room has an aesthetic, lived-in vibe, with a full-length mirror, clothes scattered on the bed, sneakers, a few fashion accessories, and soft natural daylight coming through the window. The room is slightly cluttered but realistic and cozy.

Camera and Style:

Shot on an iPhone front camera, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio, natural HDR, slight handheld movement, realistic skin texture and natural skin tones, no artificial color grading. Authentic, spontaneous UGC video style with natural lighting and realistic movements.

Outfit (laid out or partially worn):

* White oversized T-shirt with bold red stars.

* Camouflage cargo shorts or relaxed-fit camo pants.

* Bold red furry boots that stand out as the statement piece.

* Optional silver chain, wrist accessories, and a stylish watch for extra personality.

Action — One Continuous Shot:

The young man walks into the frame while adjusting his oversized T-shirt. He looks directly into the camera with a confident but slightly uncertain expression.

Dialogue:

“Okay, I'm getting ready, and I don't know if this outfit is crazy or—”

Interrupt Moment (Hook):

Suddenly, a male friend casually walks into the frame from the side, interrupting the recording.

The young man immediately turns toward him, playfully pushes him out of the frame, and says:

“Bro—nah, get out! I'm recording!”

He laughs naturally as his friend disappears from view.

He turns back to the camera, fixes his shirt, and acts like nothing happened.

Dialogue:

“Anyway… I kinda love it.”

He steps backward to reveal the complete outfit, including the oversized star-print T-shirt, camouflage bottoms, and bold red furry boots. He briefly looks down at his outfit, checks himself in the mirror, and gives a confident nod.

Dialogue:

“It's a little chaotic…”

He pauses, looks directly into the camera, and smirks.

“But it works.”

Ending:

He strikes a relaxed, confident pose, slightly turns to show the outfit from another angle, and says:

“Yeah, I'm wearing this.”

He gives a subtle grin as the video ends naturally.

Important Details:

* Stylish, confident male character with natural expressions.

* Realistic bedroom environment with a slightly messy UGC aesthetic.

* Playful interruption by a male friend.

* Natural laughter and believable interactions.

* Full-body outfit clearly visible, especially the red furry boots.

* Casual iPhone selfie-camera perspective.

* Realistic fabric textures, skin details, shadows, and body proportions.

* One continuous shot with no cuts, transitions, or cinematic camera movements.

* Spontaneous, funny, relatable social-media energy.

* Natural conversational lip-sync, with dialogue delivered exactly as written.

* No artificial beauty filters, no exaggerated acting, no background music overpowering the dialogue.

* Format: Vertical 9:16, photorealistic, suitable for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

Before he can collect them, a natural gust of wind catches the loose photographs. Several photos slide across the sidewalk while a few move toward the curb. The man immediately stops and turns around, looking worried.

SCENE 6 — PHOTO BLOWS AWAY

One photograph remains on the ground. A stronger gust pushes it farther along the sidewalk. The woman notices it immediately and follows it while the man continues collecting the others.

SCENE 7 — SHE SAVES THE LAST PHOTO

The photograph slides close to the curb. Before it can reach the road, the woman quickly but safely catches it with one hand. She looks relieved, then walks back toward the man holding the recovered photograph carefully.

Both return to the same spot. The woman places her collected photographs beside the man's. They carefully arrange all the recovered photos into one neat stack. The man counts them and realizes that the complete set has been recovered.

The man closes the photo folder securely and walks away with the photographs. The woman continues walking in the opposite direction. The camera slowly pulls back, showing the peaceful early-2000s Japanese street.

真人日系青春爱情电影，具有新海诚影片中通透明亮的夏日光影气质。

舞台は2003年頃の日本の地方都市から少し離れた農村地域。青々とした田んぼ、細い農道、電柱と電線、用水路、瓦屋根の古い日本家屋、錆びたガードレール、古びた自動販売機、遠くに見える山並み。真夏の午後の強い日差しと、どこか懐かしい日本の夏の空気が漂っています。現代的な建築物やスマートフォンなど、2003年以降の時代を感じさせるものは登場させないでください。

シーン1：家を出る

映像は、彼女が古い木造の家の玄関から出てくるところから始まります。引き戸を閉め、カメラに向かって少し照れくさそうに微笑み、スクールバッグを肩に掛け直して歩き始めます。

シーン2：田舎の道を歩く

彼女は田んぼに囲まれた細い道をゆっくり歩きます。道の脇では稲が風に揺れ、用水路を水が流れています。遠くからセミの鳴き声が聞こえます。

撮影者は少し後ろから歩きながら彼女を撮影しています。彼女は時折振り返ってカメラを見たり、何気なく笑ったりします。

シーン3：近所の人に挨拶

途中、自転車に乗った近所のおばあさんとすれ違います。彼女は自然な笑顔で「こんにちはー！」と声をかけ、小さく手を振ります。

おばあさんも笑顔で挨拶を返し、そのまま自転車で走り去ります。彼女は再び歩き始めます。

シーン4：田舎の小さな公園

彼女は小さな田舎の公園に到着します。少し錆びたブランコ、色あせた滑り台、古い木製のベンチがあります。

彼女はベンチに腰掛け、ペットボトルのお茶を一口飲みながら、くつろいで周囲を眺めます。セミの鳴き声が響き、遠くから子供たちの声が聞こえます。

撮影者が少しぎこちなくズームインすると、彼女はカメラに気づいて少し笑います。

シーン5：田んぼでカエルを見つける

公園を後にした彼女は、再び田んぼ沿いの細い農道を歩き始めます。

道端の草むらの近くを通りかかったとき、突然、小さな緑色のカエルが彼女の足元にぴょんと飛び出してきます。

彼女は「うわっ！」と驚いて小さく飛びのき、すぐに笑い出します。

彼女はしゃがみこんでカエルを覗き込み、「ちっちゃい、かわいい」と自然に呟きます。

そしてカメラの方を振り返り、「見て見て！」と笑いながら指をさします。

撮影者は慌ててカメラを下に向け、カエルにぎこちなくズームインします。一瞬ピントが外れ、草むらにいる小さなカエルに再びピントが合います。

カエルがもう一度ぴょんと跳ねると、彼女は「あはは！」と笑います。

彼女は立ち上がり、「びっくりしたー」と呟きながら、また農道を歩き始めます。

シーン6：古い駄菓子屋

彼女は田舎の細い通りを歩き続け、古い木造の駄菓子屋に立ち寄ります。

店先には色あせたアイスクリームの看板や古い飲料用冷蔵庫があり、軒先には風鈴が揺れています。店内には昔ながらの駄菓子やお菓子が並んでいます。

彼女は店のおばあさんに小銭を渡し、袋入りのアイスキャンディーをひとつ買います。

店を出ると嬉しそうに袋を開け、歩きながら最初のひと口を食べます。

冷たさに少し目を細め、無邪気に笑います。

シーン7：ペットボトルを落とす

アイスキャンディーを食べながら歩いている途中、手に持っていたペットボトルが滑り落ち、アスファルトの道に転がります。

彼女は「あっ！」と小さく声を出して立ち止まり、下を見て少し恥ずかしそうに笑います。

彼女はしゃがんでペットボトルを拾い上げ、カメラの方を一瞬見て照れ笑いを浮かべます。

そのままアイスキャンディーをもう一口食べ、何事もなかったように歩き始めます。

シーン8：田舎道でのお別れ

終盤、彼女は片手にペットボトル、もう片方の手にアイスキャンディーを持ち、夕方に差しかかる田んぼの細道をゆっくり歩いています。

背景には古い民家や電柱、遠くの山々が見えます。稲が風に揺れ、セミの声と柔らかい風の音が聞こえます。

彼女はふと振り返り、撮影している友人に向けるようにカメラを見つめます。

———

少し照れくさそうに自然な笑顔を浮かべ、「じゃあねー！バイバーイ！」と言いながら小さく手を振ります。

そのままくるりと前を向いて再び歩き始めます。

撮影者は彼女の後ろ姿を少しぎこちなく追いかけ、映像は唐突に終わります。

⸻

映像スタイル・撮影仕様

2000年代初頭の日本の一般家庭で使われていたSony HandycamやPanasonic MiniDVなど、家庭用DVカムコーダーで撮影した生の映像を忠実に再現してください。

4:3アスペクト比、480i相当の標準画質、インターレース映像の特徴、わずかなインターレースの櫛状ノイズ、柔らかいデジタルディテール、軽いDV圧縮ノイズ、当時の家庭用ビデオ特有の色再現。

手持ち撮影による微妙な揺れ、不完全なフレーミング、時折被写体が画面の端に寄る構図、オートフォーカスの迷い、明るい空を映した際の露出の変化、自然なモーションブラー、急でぎこちないズームイン・ズームアウトを含めてください。

撮影者はプロではなく、同年代の友人が何気なく彼女の日常を記録しているようなカメラワークです。

カメラは基本的に彼女の目線の高さで、近づいたり離れたりしながら撮影します。歩きながらの揺れや、撮影者が構図を直そうとする不器用な動きも自然に含めてください。

各場面は家庭用ビデオカメラで撮影された短いクリップをつなげたように、シンプルで少し唐突なカット切り替えを使用してください。映画的なトランジションや滑らかなカメラ移動は避けてください。

彼女は常にカメラを意識するのではなく、自然に歩き、笑い、周囲のものに興味を示し、時折撮影者と目を合わせます。

過剰なレトロフィルターや映画的な色調補正は避け、当時の家庭用DVカメラで本当に撮影されたかのようなリアリティを最優先してください。

音声

環境音と、その場で録音された自然な日本語の会話のみを使用してください。

セミの鳴き声、鳥の声、田んぼを吹く風、用水路の水音、遠くを走る軽トラック、自転車のブレーキ音、ローファーの足音、駄菓子屋の風鈴、ペットボトルが地面に落ちる音など。

音声は当時のDVカメラに内蔵されたマイクで録音されたように、少しこもり、風切り音や周囲の生活音が自然に混ざるものとしてください。

日本語のセリフは自然な日常会話のトーンで、演技をしているような大げさな喋り方は避けてください。

音楽、ナレーション、字幕、ビューティーフィルター、CGI、映画的な照明、シネマティックなカラーグレーディング、プロフェッショナルなカメラワーク、現代的なVlog演出は一切使用しないでください。

最重要事項

これは懐かしい日本の夏を再現した映画ではありません。

2003年の日本の田舎で、一般家庭のDVカメラを使って友人が偶然撮影した、どこにでもありそうな女子高生の日常の記録です。

意図的に演出された美しさよりも、ありふれた風景、不器用な撮影、自然な仕草、予期しない小さな出来事、当時の日本の生活感を優先してください。

登場人物の顔、髪型、制服、持ち物はすべてのカットで一貫性を保ってください。人物の入れ替わり、服装の変化、物体の突然の出現や消失、不自然な身体動作を避けてください。

Seedance 2.5 prompt:

Create an exactly 30-second vertical 16:9 premium 3D animated comedy short. Use the attached Niko character sheet as the exact visual reference for Niko. Maintain his identical face, amber-brown eyes, charcoal eye patches, ivory-white fur, charcoal-black limbs, small asymmetrical head tuft, compact pear-shaped body, short sturdy legs, oversized paws and small natural panda tail throughout every frame. Each storyboard panel represents a different moment in time, so never combine multiple Niko poses from different panels into the same frame.
The entire story takes place around one small completely frozen mountain pond during bright clear winter daylight. The pond is approximately 4.5 meters across and lies between two fixed snowy banks. Bank A is Niko's starting side and final destination. Bank B is the opposite side where the bamboo bundle is located. In all wide lateral shots, Bank A must remain on screen-left and Bank B on screen-right. During the first crossing Niko moves from left to right. During the return crossing he moves from right to left. Never mirror the world, swap the banks, reverse the geography or create a third bank.

He reaches Bank B and crashes harmlessly into deep powdery snow. His failed crossing accidentally works. He finds the bamboo beside him, picks it up and realizes he must cross the same ice again. This time he deliberately uses his belly as a slide. He hugs the bamboo against his chest, pushes off from the snow with both hind paws and glides confidently toward Bank A. He becomes overconfident and tries steering with one hind paw. That uneven drag creates rotational momentum and slowly turns his body exactly 180 degrees while he continues traveling in the same direction. He is now sliding backward toward Bank A. He reaches the bank rear-first, disappears harmlessly into deep snow, pops up still holding the bamboo and immediately takes a bite as though everything went exactly according to plan.
Use a premium realistic 3D CGI animated-film aesthetic with highly detailed soft panda fur, realistic powdery snow, subtle ice reflections, dense natural bamboo, distant snowy mountain peaks, bright crisp winter daylight, soft atmospheric depth, natural shadows and expressive but controlled physical comedy. Keep Niko cute but anatomically believable. Avoid extreme limb stretching, rubbery deformation or exaggerated facial distortion. Every major movement must have a visible physical cause. Maintain believable body weight, gravity, momentum, low friction on smooth ice and strong resistance from deep snow.

Paisaje inspirado en La Mancha: camino de tierra o sendero rural serpenteante, colinas suaves, terreno seco, pasto amarillento, tierra clara, piedras, horizonte amplio, aire castellano, luz natural. 0:18 - 0:22

author: johnAGI168
prompt:
SEEDANCE DIRECTOR PROMPT

Duration：30秒
Aspect ratio：16:9横屏
Reference / SUBJECT：@图片1＝主角。以角色卡确定主角的脸、发型、体型和服装，全片保持一致；只让这一名主角使用角色卡身份。以下正文一律使用中文名字指代，不再出现图片或视频编号。
Audio：兵器破风、金属交击、短促气劲、衣料翻动、脚步摩擦落叶、翻滚落地声；低音鼓点配合动作节奏。无对白、旁白、歌词和字幕。
Overall style：真人古装武侠电影，竹林实景，快速剑术与具有威亚感的轻功结合，真实人物和衣料质感，清楚的攻击方向、接触位置及受力反馈。短暂慢动作强调腾空、擦身避剑和剑气命中，随后恢复快速交手。

GLOBAL CONTINUITY
场景始终位于同一片竹林土路与林间空地。两侧竹林高密，地面覆盖干竹叶，远处有道路纵深，暖阳从竹梢间透下。深青绿色竹林、暖黄色日光、自然肤色，保留暗部层次。

主角右手持一把细长直剑，左手以剑指、展臂和必要的撑地动作维持平衡。剑的长度、剑柄和握持关系始终一致。数名对手穿黑色兜帽披风、深色面具及棕色内衬战衣，各持一把剑，从前方、侧方和后方交错围攻。对手与主角外貌明确不同。

包围圈内保留可供主角闪身、滑步和落地的空间。每次攻击都朝主角所在位置发出，每次格挡都有兵器接触，每次击退都有先命中、后失衡、再后退或腾空的顺序。已倒地的人继续留在对应区域。

CAMERA CONTINUITY
采用多机位动作剪辑。远景交代包围关系，中近景呈现格挡和表情，低机位全景展示翻腾与落地。切镜发生在挥剑、转身、腾空和前景遮挡过程中，保持动作方向与身体姿态连续。局部使用倾斜机位（Dutch angle）、快速横摇（Whip pan）和侧向跟拍（Tracking shot）。不将整段拍成固定机位舞剑，也不将全部动作藏在晃动和模糊里。

ACTION TIMELINE

[00–02秒｜旋剑开场、竖挡、低身转位]
开场直接进入交战。中近景，一名黑衣剑客旋身横挥，剑锋带出浅金白色、扁平椭圆状的剑痕。硬切主角正面，来剑从画面侧方切入；主角提起右手剑柄至额头上方，使剑身近竖直护在面前，接住横向攻击，左手剑指收在胸前。
短切高位俯拍，交代主角位于数名剑客包围之中。接倾斜全身镜头，主角屈膝降低重心，举剑护住上方，绕支撑脚低身旋转，衣摆沿地面展开。切中近景，主角顺势收回剑路，目光转向下一名攻击者。

[02–05秒｜跃起进攻、连续拆招]
黑衣剑客从林间冲近，其中两人先后跃起举剑攻击。低机位仰拍其跃起，再沿落下的剑路切到主角。
主角斜举直剑架住上方劈击，剑刃接触处闪出少量橙色火星；旋腕将对方兵器拨向身体外侧，脚下转位，顺势横削。另一柄剑从侧方进入，主角再次抬剑格开，接着转肩回身，让剑锋绕过身体前方反击。
镜头在正面、肩侧和对手背后切换，始终看清来剑、格挡及反击。左手剑指随转身收放，不抢到剑锋前。每次格挡立即连接下一步，不停下来摆姿势。

[05–07秒｜低位游走、旋身腾起]
切低机位全景并横向跟拍。主角屈膝滑步，身体侧倾，从两名对手交错的剑路之间穿过；转髋带肩，以右手长剑完成低位横扫。前方对手压身闪避，侧方对手举剑应对，衣摆与落叶被动作带起。
一名黑衣人从镜头前快速掠过，形成短暂遮挡。主角在遮挡后继续原来的旋转方向，完成低位转身，随即蹬地伸展、向上腾起。起跳与前面的步法连贯。

[07–10秒｜高空翻转、亮光下击、落地冲击]
切竹林通道低机位大远景，主角迅速升至包围圈上方，身体在空中翻转，衣摆拖出清楚弧线。地面剑客抬头、转身，兵器朝上戒备。
切仰拍近景，主角身体向斜下方俯冲，右臂朝前，另一只手向后上方展开，目光锁定下方；前伸手与兵器所在位置出现集中的蓝白亮点，短暂照亮脸部与衣袖。竹叶从前后景掠过，保留明显纵深。
切回低位远景，亮光向下拉成短促气劲轨迹。主角下落时，气劲先触及地面中心，尘土和落叶沿地面向四周推开，附近对手踉跄退让。主角穿过尘雾落地，屈膝消化冲力，立即接入下一次转身。冲击呈现气浪、浮尘和飞叶，不出现火球或地面巨大裂缝。

[10–12秒｜落地接扫、贴地横移]
低机位横向跟随主角。落地的身体重心继续向侧方移动，主角借转髋带动长剑横扫，压低躯干，从对手的攻击线下穿过。衣摆斜向拖曳，鞋底带起薄薄尘土。
对手一人后撤，一人从另一侧补进。主角从低姿起身，借同一股旋转惯性回身迎剑。前景披风短暂遮住画面，切镜后动作继续。

[12–14秒｜近身格挡、仰身避剑]
切中景，主角与近处黑衣剑客连续交手。对方横斩，主角举剑接住并向侧边拨开；对方紧接着回斩，主角侧转肩膀反削，左臂向外展开维持平衡。
下一柄剑朝头部横掠，主角先仰身使剑锋从面前擦过，再收下颌、折髋低头，从后续剑路下钻过。镜头贴着剑锋运动但保留脸和肩部轮廓。低头闪避直接成为后续腾跃的蓄势。

[14–17秒｜横身腾跃、撑地侧翻、连续翻转]
切低机位全身镜头。主角从俯身姿态蹬地，躯干横向展开，双腿先后离地，在对手剑路上方完成近水平的侧向腾跃。衣摆沿身体旋转方向甩开，落脚后不停顿，立即压低身体继续转动。
左手短暂撑地承重，髋部抬起，双腿依次越过身体侧上方，完成快速侧向翻转；右手保持握剑，让剑锋离开撑地手与身体。手掌离地、双脚重新承重后，再接一次头下脚上的腾空翻转，越过从旁扫来的兵器。
淡金白色的细弧拖尾沿真实剑路与翻转轨迹短暂出现，随后消散。敌人披风数次从前景掠过，后方对手持续追击。以切镜压缩动作间隙，保留每个动作的起势、倒转和落地。

[17–20秒｜回身横扫、剑气掀飞、翻滚落地]
切主角上半身，主角转腕回剑，剑锋经过肩侧，目光快速转向身后。黑衣剑客从侧后方跃入，主角转身处理逼近的剑路，再由脚下转动带动腰、肩、右臂，完成一次有完整幅度的水平横扫。
切主角背侧中远景：一片宽而薄、略带烟尘质感的浅金灰白色弧形剑气，沿腰胸高度向前扩开。剑气从挥剑动作中产生，沿同一方向推进。
前方数名剑客先被气浪带动衣服，随后躯干失衡、双脚离地，向后掀起。切侧面全景，分别呈现有人横飞、有人翻转、有人背部落地后继续滚动；落地伴随尘土、竹叶和重击声。主角完成横扫后的展开姿势与前镜连续。

[20–23秒｜后仰翻腾避横扫、低位接空中来剑]
一名仍站立的剑客旋身发出横向攻击。切主角近景，主角抬眼发现剑路，迅速后仰，浅金色剑痕贴着脸部上方掠过。
借后仰继续蹬地，双腿向上翻过头顶，完成向后翻腾；落地时压低重心，顺势将剑迎向另一名腾空而来的敌人。对方从侧上方挥剑，主角在低姿中向上格挡，交锋处出现短促亮痕，随即消失。
用一段侧面全景保留“主角在低位、敌人在半空”的高低关系；穿插隔着前景竹竿观看交战的远景，再切回主角低身转位。主角从头到尾持续注视对手的攻击方向。

[23–25秒｜低身上挑、对手翻起]
倾斜中景，主角沿地面侧移，右手剑尖先低后高，随着腿部起势与转肩向斜上方挑出。左手收回胸前，身体保持低位。
对手先出现短促命中反应和少量红色命中痕迹，再胸腹后仰、双脚离地，向后翻转。主角剑臂停在斜上方，画面前方的黑衣人翻过后落地，披风和棕色衣片延迟摆动。镜头保留对手失衡、腾起、倒转的顺序。

[25–26秒｜横身飞跃、接触绕身]
切侧面广角全景。主角从画面右侧跃向另一名持剑对手，身体伸展至近水平，双腿与衣摆拖在后方。
主角前伸的手臂与对手高举的持剑手、兵器相接，在这个接触位置附近绕过对手侧上方；对手随之转肩、转脚跟随，主角横身运动连续，不能从对手身体中穿过，也不能无接触地悬浮绕圈。
保留两人近处的接触关系，主角绕到对手侧后方下降，脚落地后立刻进入近身剑招。淡色剑痕沿横向运动短暂拉开。

[26–28秒｜近身斩击、贴身错位]
切中近景，主角落地后直接转腕挥剑，剑锋横过身前，近处对手受击、躬身退开，只有短促红色命中痕迹。
紧接另一名黑衣剑客逼近，主角贴身错步转到其侧后方；插入极短特写，银色剑身横过对手颈前位置，随即切回主角回身完成剑路，对手失去平衡倒向画面边缘。动作迅速克制，不展示伤口细节。
主角结束这一轮交手时，一手持剑向前下方伸出，另一臂向后展开，视线越过剑锋检查周围。

[28–30秒｜转腕收势、全景落幕]
节奏逐渐放缓。中近景，主角转腕将剑带回肩侧，再缓缓放低至身体一侧；衣袖、发丝与漂浮竹叶继续自然摆动。主角目光从前方移向侧面，呼吸与肩部只有轻微变化。
最后硬切低机位全景：主角独立在竹林空地中央，直剑斜向下指，周围黑衣剑客倒在地面，地面浮尘渐散，竹林纵深与开场一致。保留短暂稳定的结束画面。

VFX RULES
剑刃接触才有橙色小火星；剑痕只跟随实际挥剑方向。
浅金白色剑痕呈细弧、扁环或薄片，保留透明度。
空中下击采用集中的蓝白亮点、向下轨迹、地面扩散尘浪。
大范围击退采用横向宽薄剑气，先到达对手，再触发腾空与落地。
衣料、竹叶、灰尘随运动方向与气浪先后响应。
亮光短暂，不持续遮脸，不把人物轮廓吞没。

NEGATIVE
换脸，主角复制，身份混淆
剑身增殖，武器变形，握柄脱离
额外手脚，关节反折，身体穿插

2000年代初頭の日本の田舎の高校を舞台にした、30秒間の超リアルなハイスピード・アクション映像を作成してください。

映像は最初から最後まで完全なワンカット。カメラの切り替え、編集によるジャンプ、場面転換、暗転は一切ありません。

主人公と世界観

主人公は添付画像の日本人女子高生。顔立ち、髪型、体型、制服のデザインを参照画像と厳密に一致させてください。

彼女は短めのプリーツスカートの制服を着ており、活発で自然な表情をしています。激しく走っても人物の外見と制服の一貫性を維持してください。

舞台は2003年頃の日本の地方にある公立高校。古い木造風の机、黒板、緑色の掲示板、蛍光灯、長い廊下、古い階段、下駄箱の並んだ昇降口、広い土の校庭。窓の外には田んぼと遠くの山並みが見えます。

学校には大勢の日本人高校生がいます。男子生徒も女子生徒も、全員が同じ瞬間に下校するため、学校中が異常なほどの大混雑になります。

0〜5秒：下校チャイム、全員が一斉に走り出す

古い日本の高校の教室。窓から午後の強い日差しが差し込み、生徒たちは授業終了を待っています。

突然、学校中に大きな下校チャイムが鳴り響きます。

チャイムが鳴り始めた瞬間、教室の全生徒が一斉に立ち上がり、まるでレースのスタートのように猛烈な勢いで出口へ駆け出します。

椅子が倒れ、机が揺れ、教科書やプリントが宙を舞います。生徒たちは歓声を上げながら廊下へ殺到します。

カメラは主人公の女子高生を素早く捉え、彼女が勢いよく教室から飛び出す瞬間に急加速して追跡を開始します。

5〜11秒：暴走する廊下と飛んでくる机

主人公が廊下を全力疾走します。

カメラは彼女の背後から猛烈な速度で追いかけます。廊下には大量の生徒が走っており、左右から次々と人が飛び出してきます。

突然、隣の教室の開いた扉から机が勢いよく廊下に飛び出してきます。

主人公は直前で身体をひねり、机をギリギリでかわします。

この瞬間だけ一瞬スローモーションになり、机がカメラのすぐ横を通過します。木製の机が床を滑る轟音、舞い上がる紙、驚く生徒たちの表情。

回避した瞬間、映像は急激に通常速度以上へ戻り、主人公は走り続けます。

カメラは彼女の横へ回り込み、再び背後へ移動します。

11〜17秒：階段と次々に現れる障害物

主人公は廊下の角を鋭く曲がり、階段へ飛び込みます。

大量の生徒たちが階段を駆け下りており、怒号、足音、笑い声が反響しています。

カメラは手すりのすぐ横を高速ですり抜けながら、彼女を追い続けます。

階段の途中で、上から転がってきた大きな運動用マットが進路を塞ぎます。

主人公は素早くしゃがみ、マットの下を滑るように潜り抜けます。

カメラも彼女の動きに合わせて一気に低くなり、床すれすれを滑走します。

次の瞬間、彼女は立ち上がって再び全力疾走。カメラも勢いよく上昇します。

すべてのアクションは物理的に連続しており、カットを使わずに撮影されています。

17〜23秒：昇降口から校庭へ

主人公は下駄箱の並ぶ昇降口へ飛び出します。

大量の生徒が次々と校舎から外へ走り出し、まるでマラソン大会のスタート直後のような光景が広がります。

主人公は人混みを縫うように走り抜け、明るい校庭へ飛び出します。

カメラは一瞬、校舎の暗い室内から強い屋外の日差しに対応できず白飛びし、すぐに露出が回復します。

校庭には数百人の生徒がさまざまな方向へ全力疾走しており、土埃が舞い上がっています。

カメラは主人公を見失わず、彼女の横を並走しながら激しく回り込みます。

23〜30秒：校庭の中心にある布団

主人公は校庭の中央へ向かって一直線に走ります。

そこには、なぜか白い敷布団とふかふかの掛け布団、枕がきれいに用意されています。

周囲の生徒たちも次々に校庭を走り抜けていきます。

主人公は最後の数メートルでさらに加速し、布団の直前で勢いよく滑り込むように飛び込みます。

この瞬間だけ短いスローモーション。彼女の髪が揺れ、布団が大きく沈み込み、掛け布団がふわりと舞い上がります。

すぐに通常速度に戻り、彼女は素早く掛け布団を身体に掛け、枕に頭を乗せます。

たった今まで全力疾走していたことが嘘のように、彼女は目を閉じて気持ちよさそうに眠ります。

カメラは布団のすぐ近くまで勢いよく接近し、最後は彼女の眠っている顔を映します。

背景では、他の大勢の生徒たちがまだ全力で走り続けています。

彼女だけが完全に静止し、穏やかに眠っています。

映像はここで終了します。

⸻

カメラワーク・映像表現

30秒間、完全なシングルテイク。どの瞬間にもカット、編集によるジャンプ、場面転換、被写体の瞬間移動を使用しないでください。

2000年代初頭の家庭用DVカムコーダーの映像特性をベースにしながら、アクション映画のような極めてダイナミックなカメラワークを実現してください。

カメラは主人公から離れず、背後からの追跡、横方向への並走、低い位置への急降下、鋭い方向転換、前方への回り込みを連続的に行います。

手持ちカメラ特有の激しい揺れ、走る振動、素早いパン、不完全なフレーミング、被写体の一瞬の見切れ、素早いオートフォーカスの変化を含めてください。

スピードランプを効果的に使用してください。通常速度から瞬間的な加速、危険を回避する瞬間の短いスローモーション、再び高速への復帰を自然に組み合わせます。

スローモーションは全体の一部に限定し、映像の大部分は猛烈なスピード感を維持してください。

DVカメラらしい柔らかいデジタルディテール、軽いノイズ、強い動きによるモーションブラー、露出の変動、わずかな圧縮ノイズを含めます。

意図的に作り込まれた映画的なカラーグレーディングは使用せず、2003年頃の日本の学校で実際に撮影されたような生々しい映像にしてください。

音声

自然な現場音を中心に、下校チャイム、生徒たちの歓声、無数の足音、机や椅子が倒れる音、紙が舞う音、階段の反響、風切り音、校庭を走る足音、布団に飛び込む音を明瞭に再現してください。

音声はカメラの移動に合わせてリアルタイムで変化します。室内では音が反響し、校庭に出ると一気に開放的な音響へ変化します。

日本語の叫び声や笑い声は自然に混ざりますが、ナレーションや説明的なセリフはありません。

BGM、字幕、テロップ、ロゴは使用しないでください。

最重要事項

30秒間、完全なワンカットであること。

主人公の顔、髪型、制服は添付画像と一貫させること。

学校中の大勢の生徒が同時に動き、空間全体が生きているような臨場感を出すこと。

カメラは猛烈な速度で主人公を追い続け、アクション、障害物、回避動作を一切カットせずに捉えること。

机や運動用マットなどの障害物は非現実的なほど激しく動きますが、映像そのものは実写として信じられる質感にしてください。危険な接触や負傷はなく、主人公は鮮やかにすべてを回避します。

最後に校庭の中央に置かれた布団で突然眠るというシュールな結末を、登場人物が当然のように受け入れている世界観で描写してください。

極端なスピード感、群衆のダイナミックな動き、ワンカット特有の緊張感、そして最後の静かな眠りとの強烈なコントラストを最優先してください。

prompt:
制作一段完整30秒的高品质电影级奇幻冒险动画短片。严格参考输入视频中的女主角外貌、服装、发型、红色滑板造型、山谷环境、瀑布、悬崖、镜头运动、动作节奏和整体视觉风格。

故事发生在一片壮丽的奇幻高山峡谷中。一位拥有黑色长发的年轻女性冒险者踩着一块鲜红色的魔法冲浪板，在长满青草的陡峭山坡上高速滑行，随后冲出悬崖，飞越巨大的瀑布湖泊，在半空中完成惊险的跳跃，最终落向瀑布对岸的狭窄山脊。整段动画强调高速运动、真实的惯性、惊险的腾空动作、宏伟的自然环境和充满表现力的角色表演。

女主角是一位年轻、勇敢、敏捷的亚洲女性冒险者，拥有修长而富有运动感的身材、柔和但鲜明的面部轮廓、大而富有表现力的深色眼睛、自然的眉毛和清晰的鼻梁。

她拥有一头浓密、柔顺的黑色长发，头发长度超过肩膀，在高速运动中向后大幅飘扬，形成强烈的动态轮廓。

她穿着白色的短款抹胸式上衣，露出腰腹部，外面披着一件宽松的浅米白色短袖外套。外套采用柔软轻薄的布料，在风中不断向后摆动。

下半身穿着深灰黑色宽松长裤，裤腿具有自然的褶皱和布料运动效果。腰部采用深色腰带，脚穿深色轻便运动鞋。

她始终保持年轻、勇敢、机敏的气质，动作灵活，拥有优秀的身体平衡能力。

表情随着冒险过程不断变化：开始时专注而自信，高速滑行时充满兴奋，飞跃巨大瀑布时表现出惊讶和紧张，最终恢复坚定的神情。

【红色魔法滑板】

女主角脚下是一块鲜红色的长条形魔法冲浪板。

滑板具有流线型的修长轮廓，前端微微向上弯曲，后端逐渐收窄，整体形状类似结合冲浪板与飞行滑板的奇幻运动装备。

滑板表面呈现鲜艳的朱红色和橙红色，具有干净的绘画质感与柔和高光。

滑板没有轮子、机械推进器或明显的金属结构。

它能够贴着草地高速滑行，也能够借助速度和地形短暂腾空，在空中保持自然的抛物线运动轨迹。

滑板的运动必须符合角色的身体重心、脚部姿势和惯性变化。

【场景设定】

故事发生在一片宏伟的奇幻高山瀑布峡谷。

峡谷两侧是高耸的灰蓝色岩石峭壁，岩石表面具有清晰的几何切面、柔和的绘画笔触和自然的风化纹理。

山坡覆盖大片明亮的黄绿色草地，生长着低矮灌木、苔藓和零散的野花。

峡谷内部有巨大的蓝色湖泊，湖水清澈，表面反射天空的蓝色和周围岩壁的颜色。

远处数条壮观的白色瀑布从高耸悬崖倾泻而下，形成大量白色水雾和翻滚的水花。

湖泊中央散布着覆盖青苔的巨大岩石，部分岩石露出水面。

一棵巨大的古老树木生长在山坡边缘，粗壮的树干向外延伸，深绿色树冠在天空中形成自然的遮挡。

峡谷深处存在古老的石质遗迹，灰白色建筑依附于悬崖表面，具有圆形洞口、石桥、拱形门洞和被绿色植物覆盖的屋顶。

天空湛蓝，漂浮着大片蓬松的白色积云。明亮的午后阳光照亮草地、岩壁和湖泊，形成温暖的金色高光与清凉的蓝色阴影。

【3–6秒｜沿着陡峭山坡加速】

她站在红色滑板上，双脚前后分开，膝盖弯曲，身体重心降低。

prompt:
Video prompt 

A heavy-lift rocket tears off a coastal launch pad at first light, and the marsh three kilometres away only hears it long after the vehicle has climbed out of frame.

Shot 1 - 0.0s to 5.0s - EWS, low angle looking up from the marsh edge, locked-off. First light on a flat coastal plain: a grey unmarked launch vehicle stands on a steel tower between a black water channel and a mile of dead reed beds, the sky behind it going from slate to sulphur. Frost rimes the vehicle's upper tank in patchy white plates. At 1.8s its vent valves exhale a thin white breath to the left, and a flock of birds lifts out of the reeds in one motion at 3.2s, crossing frame right to left, unhurried and unconcerned. Nothing else moves. The tower's floodlights are still lit against the coming day.
Hard cut.

Shot 2 - 5.0s to 10.0s - MCU, low angle at the base of the tower, handheld. At 5.0s the frame is nothing but machinery and concrete: hold-down clamps the size of cars, a flame trench mouthing black, deluge pipes beaded with condensation. At 5.6s the ignition lights - a white core under the vehicle that swells rather than appears, and the frame's whole shadow structure flips in a single frame. By 6.4s the deluge water meeting the flame trench flashes to steam, and the steam does not rise politely: it erupts outward and down, rolling over the camera position and turning the frame to white-grey at 7.8s. The handheld frame takes the shock physically, one hard jolt at 6.1s, then steadies as the sound of it arrives.
Hard cut.

Shot 3 - 10.0s to 15.0s - MS, low angle following the vehicle's base, crane mount. At 10.0s the hold-downs release: four bolts shear at once and the vehicle's base jumps upward, the machine answering with a lurch that shakes frost off the tank in white sheets. The ice plates fall in the vehicle's own wash, tumbling end over end, some of them shattering on the concrete apron at 12.4s. The camera cranes up at 1.6 m/s, tracking the rising base as it clears the tower's crossbeams, and the exhaust plume below it grows a hard bright core wrapped in a rolling grey skirt.
Hard cut.

Shot 4 - 15.0s to 20.0s - EWS, high angle looking down from above and behind the tower, drone. At 15.0s the vehicle is a bright nail head punching through the top of its own steam cloud, the tower below it still dripping deluge water from every level and the concrete apron black with wet. The cloud spreads sideways across the pad rather than climbing, driven by the pressure wave, and by 18.2s the pad is a lake of steam with the tower's tip sticking out of it. The vehicle's contrail has formed as one clean white line leaning out over the water to the east.
Hard cut.

Shot 5 - 20.0s to 25.0s - WS, low angle on the marsh, locked-off at water level. At 20.0s the frame is quiet, empty and cold: still black water, reeds standing, one bird settling back onto a post. At 21.3s the sound arrives - the water rings outward in concentric circles from nowhere in particular, the reed bed flattens in one direction and stays flattened, and the single bird is gone in a single frame. Nothing else appears. The launch is three kilometres away and completely invisible; only its pressure is here.
Hard cut.

Shot 6 - 25.0s to 30.0s - EWS, low angle looking east over the marsh, slow dolly forward at 0.3 m/s. At 25.0s the vehicle is a small bright point still burning above the horizon, the contrail now a long unbroken white seam across the sulphur sky, and the pad's steam has thinned to a soft ground haze that catches the first direct light. Frost still sits in the reeds' shadows. The frame arrives at full daylight with the sound already gone.
Camera law: 35mm anamorphic throughout; the mount family moves from locked-off to handheld to crane to drone and back to locked-off; height never rises above the vehicle's base except in shot four; 180 degree motion blur. Anti-default: in shot two, a deluge pipe in the near foreground stays almost dry while steam pours behind it, defocused across the lower frame.

Grade and audio: gold-hour amber palette - sulphur, wet concrete grey, one white plume - contrast pushed high with blacks crushed. Key light is the rising sun directly behind the tower in shot one, then the engine's own light becomes the key from shot two onward, halation blooming where the plume burns through the steam. Audio: a low wind and water bed under five diegetic events - frost cracking on the tank, hold-down bolts shearing, deluge water flashing to steam, ice plates shattering on concrete, and one low pressure boom arriving late at the marsh.

Constraints: Count of shots: six. Count of people in frame: zero. Count of visible vehicles: one. Count of birds in shot five: one. Count of logos, insignia or lettering on the vehicle and tower: zero. No music, no score, no bgm. No subtitles.

[Global Setting] 30-second cinematic macro surrealism, 16:9, 4K, photoreal, poetic VFX. A dark concert hall, a single warm spotlight. A violinist plays an old polished wooden violin. Inside the violin lives a miniature ocean that reacts to the music. No text on screen.

[0–5s] Extreme macro close-up. The bow touches the strings in the spotlight. Through the f-shaped sound hole, faint blue light ripples, and the sound of waves mixes with the first notes.

[5–12s] The camera glides closer. Inside the wooden body: a calm miniature ocean. Tiny waves break against cliffs of polished golden wood. Small sailing ships drift between the strings vibrating like glowing bridges above.

[12–18s] The camera dives through the sound hole into the miniature world, flying low over the waves among the tiny ships.

[18–25s] The music rises. The sea turns to storm: dark clouds of rosin dust, massive waves crashing on the wooden cliffs, ships tossed. Each sharp note becomes a bolt of golden lightning striking the water.

[25–30s] Final crescendo. The camera rises back out through the sound hole and pulls back: the violinist revealed, eyes closed, alone on stage in the spotlight, sea spray glittering in the air around the violin. Hold.

[Camera] Smooth macro glides, one continuous dive in and out. No cuts, no shake.

[Audio] Solo violin, calm then intense, waves and creaking wood, wind, thunder in sync with each note, final note echoing in the empty hall.

[Consistency] Same violin, same violinist, same warm spotlight. Ocean always inside the instrument.
2/2

Present-day scenes feature desaturated green-grey tones, decaying architecture, drifting dust, and cold overcast light. Memories feature warm amber sunlight, rich natural colors, and gentle halation. Emotional restraint over melodrama.

Character continuity — keep identical faces throughout:

Man: Early 30s, short messy dark-brown hair, light stubble, silver curb chain, small silver hoop in his left ear. Present-day appearance: shirtless, dark trousers, ashy grey-green skin, mottled veins, cracked lips, dirt-covered shoulders, bruising around the eyes. His irises are clouded milky-grey, with faintly veined pale sclera and small, dull pupils. His gaze remains subtly responsive. Memory appearance: healthy olive skin, dark charcoal crewneck, warm brown eyes, natural smile.

Woman: Early 30s, long wavy dirty-blonde hair, small silver nose ring, oversized black knit sweater in the present. Her skin is pale and ashy, with realistic discoloration, faint veins, and dark bruising around the eye sockets. Her irises have a cloudy blue-grey film, glassy surfaces, and muted pupils. Memory appearance: healthy skin, heather-grey T-shirt, clear blue-grey eyes, expressive laughter.

Shot-by-shot sequence

0.0–3.0s — The abandoned station

A wide cinematic shot of a deserted railway platform swallowed by weeds. A derailed train rests beneath a broken glass canopy. The infected man sits alone on a rusted bench, staring at an old photograph held between dirty fingers. Wind moves loose paper across the platform. He slowly lifts his head as faint footsteps echo in the distance. His cloudy eyes turn toward the sound. Slow dolly-in, cold green-grey palette, atmospheric silence.

3.0–5.5s — Recognition

At the far end of the platform, the infected woman emerges through drifting mist. Her oversized black sweater hangs loosely from her shoulders, her dirty-blonde hair moving in the wind. She stops beneath a flickering station light. A medium close-up reveals her pale, filmed-over irises and bruised eye sockets. She studies the distant figure as though trying to remember his face. The camera slowly pushes toward her eyes.

5.5–8.0s — The distance between them

Alternating profile shots as they walk toward each other along opposite sides of the platform. Neither moves like a predator. Their steps are uneven and hesitant. The man brushes his fingertips across a rusted metal railing; the woman pauses beside an abandoned child’s bicycle. Their dead eyes remain fixed on one another. A train carriage slides across the foreground, briefly obscuring the frame and revealing them much closer when it clears.

8.0–10.5s — The familiar gesture

They stop face-to-face beneath a shattered station clock. The woman raises one trembling hand and touches the silver chain around his neck, recognizing something familiar. He looks down at her hand, then back into her eyes. His expression barely changes, but his breathing catches faintly. Extreme close-up on their fingers touching the chain, followed by a rack focus to their clouded eyes. No snarling, no sudden movements.

10.5–12.0s — Memory begins

Her thumb brushes the chain.

Match cut to the same gesture in the past: her healthy hand resting against the same silver necklace as the man smiles at her in warm afternoon sunlight. The cold station transforms into a sunlit apartment balcony through a seamless visual transition. The soundtrack remains instrumental, with a delicate piano motif and distant ambient textures.

12.0–14.0s — A life they once had

Memory. The couple stand in a tiny apartment kitchen, cooking together. She playfully steals a piece of food from his plate. He pretends to be offended before breaking into a genuine laugh. Their clear brown and blue-grey eyes reflect the warm window light. Imperfect handheld framing, natural movement, lived-in surroundings, intimate realism rather than polished advertising aesthetics.

14.0–16.0s — The last ordinary day

Memory. They ride a bicycle together along a quiet countryside road at sunset, the woman seated behind him with her arms around his waist. She rests her cheek against his back and closes her eyes. Tall grass sways beside the road. Golden sunlight spills through the trees. The camera follows from behind, creating the feeling of a cherished moment captured before anyone knew it would become a memory.

16.0–18.0s — The world before

A brief, fragmented memory: rain against a bedroom window at night. They lie together beneath a blanket, foreheads touching, smiling quietly. Her fingers trace his cheek while he gently tucks a strand of hair behind her ear. Their eyes are alive, moist, and full of warmth. A lightning flash momentarily illuminates their faces, creating a natural visual bridge to the cold present.

18.0–20.0s — Back to the station

Hard match cut to the same framing in the abandoned station. The woman’s hand is still against his cheek, but the skin beneath her fingers is cracked and grey. Her eyes are cloudy and lifeless in color. His dull milky-grey eyes remain locked on hers. The piano falls away, leaving only wind passing through broken windows and the faint metallic groan of the station.

20.0–22.0s — The almost-human moment

Extreme close-up, both faces filling the frame. The man slowly raises his hand and rests it against the woman’s cheek. A tear-like trace of moisture catches the light beneath her clouded eye, without restoring its color. She leans into his palm by the smallest amount. Their noses almost touch. Fine cracks, subtle veins, dirt, and realistic skin deterioration remain sharply detailed. No supernatural glow, no sudden transformation.

22.0–24.0s — Still together

A wider shot from behind them. They sit side by side on the rusted station bench, hands clasped, facing the abandoned tracks disappearing into the mist. Weeds move in the wind. Far above, the broken canopy lets one narrow beam of golden sunlight fall across their joined hands. The rest of the station remains cold and lifeless. The camera slowly pulls away until they become small figures in the ruined architecture.

End on their clasped hands. Fade to black. No title card.

Cinematography and performance

* Prioritize emotional storytelling through eyes, hands, posture, and subtle facial movement.
* Use motivated match cuts that connect identical gestures, compositions, and character positions across past and present.
* Maintain consistent facial identity, hairstyle, jewelry, clothing, and body proportions in every shot.

* Build emotion through visual contrast, ambient sound, and restrained pacing rather than dialogue or excessive effects.

Unlimited Seedance 2.5:  

PROMPT ⬇️

Create a 15-second, horizontal 16:9, photorealistic live-action extreme-sports commercial for Red Bull.

Generate from text only. No reference images.

Exactly 8 shots, 7 clean hard cuts. Real-time HIGH-SPEED action, never slow motion. Already-developed burnout: release at 0.15, hard forward surge by 0.25, first cut at 0.60 seconds. She accelerates hard, jumps, completes one FAST backflip and descends onto a moving aircraft. No hovering or prolonged level glide.

The aircraft is the late reveal. Do not show it before Shot 5. Make the action exciting, spatially coherent and easy to follow.

MILA

MILA — a beautiful American Instagram-style brunette model and performer, 20. Long dark-brown hair in a high ponytail, glossy lips, expressive eyes, soft glam makeup and delicate sparkly stud earrings.

Slim athletic figure with an extremely large, very full bust with pronounced forward projection, exceptionally large, full rounded buttocks, a narrow waist, flat stomach and lean arms and legs. Her bust has much greater volume than a typical large bust, visibly oversized relative to her narrow ribcage. Keep the increased volume concentrated in her bust and buttocks; preserve her slim shoulders, waist, arms and legs.

Preserve her facial identity, high ponytail and body proportions across all shots. Her chest retains its full volume when she leans over the tank; do not flatten or shrink it. Natural anatomy, support and gravity appropriate to her position.

She looks confident and focused, with a small challenging smile in the opening. Once she starts moving, her attention turns to the route and the landing. No frightened screaming or exaggerated facial expressions.

OUTFIT

A fitted dark charcoal athletic crop top with a muted red-and-blue graphic pattern, thin silver-grey straps and a deep scoop neckline showing prominent cleavage. Opaque, supportive fabric, a secure fit and the same neckline throughout. Her shoulders, arms and midriff are bare.

Tight black leather motorcycle trousers follow her narrow waist, rounded hips and full buttocks. Subtle protective panels, real seams and natural leather creases. Black motorcycle gloves and black riding boots.

Keep this exact outfit in every action shot. No jacket, racing suit, costume transformation or sudden addition of garments. Her face and ponytail remain visible.

MOTORCYCLE AND BRANDING

One full-size BMW sport motorcycle in navy-blue, silver and red livery. Keep the Red Bull emblem and "Red Bull" lettering on its fairings. Add a small BMW roundel on the upper side fairing: black ring, white "BMW", blue-and-white quartered centre. Both physical brands are visible in the opening.

Consistent fairing shape, windscreen, tank, exhaust, wheels and livery throughout. Correct motorcycle scale relative to MILA. Exactly two wheels, correctly connected forks and suspension.

The motorcycle has no wings or flying mechanisms. It follows a continuous airborne trajectory after leaving the ramp. MILA stays on the same motorcycle throughout the stunt.

During the stunt, hands stay on grips and legs on opposite sides of the bike. No fused hands or knees passing through the tank.

One closed Red Bull can is secured through the stunt in a locking holder beside the cockpit, visible in the opening. Only after stopping does she retrieve, open and drink from this SAME can.

LOCATION AND SPATIAL LOGIC

A high skyscraper rooftop above a dense modern city in ordinary late-morning daylight, with a blue sky and scattered white clouds.

The rooftop has a broad, firmly supported metal acceleration lane ending in a curved launch ramp. The approach is long enough to establish visible acceleration before takeoff. It has continuous support under both tires.

In the opening close shot, the launch lip is farther ahead, OUTSIDE the frame. Do not put her front wheel over the rooftop edge while she is stationary. A burnout spins the rear tire while the motorcycle remains in place; forward acceleration begins only when she launches.

The city skyline establishes the height, but keep the first shot tight on MILA and the motorcycle. Reveal the larger environment after the first cut.

Preserve the travel direction: the motorcycle moves toward screen right in exterior side views. The aircraft later travels in that same direction.

AIRCRAFT AND LANDING PLATFORM

A large, realistically built cargo aircraft in Red Bull livery flies below and ahead of the motorcycle's trajectory. It has a substantial flat stunt landing deck mounted lengthwise above its central fuselage, supported by visible structural brackets.

The deck is a deliberate physical structure wide enough for the motorcycle and long enough for a short rollout. Its unobstructed landing surface faces upward and remains approximately horizontal.

The aircraft is already flying steadily along the same route before it enters the frame. The reveal comes from framing, not from an aircraft suddenly materializing.

At landing, the deck and motorcycle travel in the same direction with a small relative horizontal speed. MILA descends onto the rear portion of the deck, rolls forward and brakes while remaining aboard. Keep the wheels clear of the deck edges and aircraft components.

The aircraft remains level during the landing and rollout. No sudden barrel roll, wing deformation or platform appearing only at the instant of contact.

CAMERA AND LOOK

DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel.

Use this as a restrained tactile recording character: slight human framing imperfections, small exposure adjustments, subtle tape texture and natural motion blur. Keep faces, branding, tire contact and the stunt clearly readable.

Low ramp coverage shows metal seams rushing past with strong parallax and directional blur. Aerial tracking briefly lags the bike; buildings move rapidly behind and below it. Do not lock the bike motionless against the skyline or pass the camera through physical objects.

Photographed skin, individual hair strands, leather creases, rubber, metal and painted fairings. Ordinary daylight, high sun, natural shadows, neutral white balance and skin tones. No sunset, amber wash, golden rim light or orange-and-teal grading.

The first shot has a close, low three-quarter side angle, approximately front-axle height. MILA's face, neckline, torso and hips dominate the composition above the motorcycle. The tank and front fairing create a strong diagonal toward screen right. The background is softer than her face and the bike.

Keep the lighting and skin tones consistent as the coverage changes. No cartoon finish, plastic skin or exaggerated lens effects.

STORYBOARD — 15 SECONDS

SHOT 1 — 0.0–0.6 SECONDS
TAIL END OF BURNOUT, EXPLOSIVE RELEASE

Close, low three-quarter side composition. The burnout began before the clip; show only its final instant and the launch. No preparation or held pose.

MILA leans over the tank, hands on grips. Her dark patterned top, extremely large full bust, narrow waist, leather trousers and confident face are readable. The Red Bull graphic on the near fairing is visible.

0.00–0.15: rear tire ALREADY spinning, front wheel held still. Substantial white-grey smoke already trails left from the REAR contact patch. No smoke buildup. Eyes immediately follow the route; one boot supports her balance.

Release the front brake at 0.15. By 0.25 the front wheel rolls and the bike surges toward screen right. Her supporting boot lifts onto its peg during this movement.

0.25–0.60: hard acceleration, torso braced, ramp streaking past. The camera pans but falls behind. Leave the smoke behind; no stationary hold inside it.

Keep part of the rear contact patch visible initially. Smoke stays clear of her face and branding. No flames.

HARD CUT at 0.60, during acceleration. Never extend this shot to one second.

SHOT 2 — 0.6–3.0 SECONDS
HARD ACCELERATION TO THE RAMP

Cut into the SAME acceleration, already fast. Wider low rear-side tracking view: metal seams and supports sweep rapidly past.

Reveal the rooftop lane and curved launch ramp, rapidly closing toward its lip. No second start or slow approach.

Leave the smoke behind. Boots on pegs, torso low, ponytail streaming backward. Speed and engine load keep building.

Carry full speed up the ramp. End JUST BEFORE takeoff, rear tire still on the ramp. Show takeoff and the entire flip in the next unbroken shot.

SHOT 3 — 3.0–6.5 SECONDS
ONE COMPLETE 360-DEGREE BACKFLIP, THEN DESCENT

Cut to external SIDE-PROFILE tracking before takeoff. Show final rear-tire contact and decisive forward/upward launch around 3.1. No pause or elevator-like lift.

Keep the whole rider and bike visible through the complete rotation in ONE UNINTERRUPTED SHOT. Camera tracks sideways, horizon level, orientation side-on. No camera roll or orbit imitating a flip.

MILA and the connected bike rotate backward together through exactly 360 degrees about the bike's transverse pitch axis, parallel to its wheel axles. Keep their forward travel toward screen right. No sideways twist or barrel roll.

ONE FAST, CONTINUOUS rotation through these orientations, with no held poses:
Around 3.5: nose and front wheel point UP; front wheel above rear wheel.
Around 3.9: fully INVERTED; both wheels ABOVE MILA, bike nose pointing LEFT.
Around 4.3: CONTINUE THE SAME ROTATION through nose-DOWN; front wheel clearly BELOW rear wheel.
By 4.7: complete the circle, wheels BELOW MILA again, nose pointing RIGHT.

The nose-DOWN phase after inversion MUST be visible. Never reverse from upside-down back through nose-UP: that is rocking, not a backflip. No reversal, reset, missing quarter-turn or cut hiding an incomplete flip.

Hands on grips, boots on pegs, MILA astride the same connected bike. Maintain its geometry.

4.7–6.5: continue the SAME ballistic arc, fast forward travel and accelerating descent, nose slightly below horizon. Camera briefly lags; she crosses the frame as buildings race past at different depths. Wheels-down does NOT mean level flight. No second flip or hovering.

SHOT 4 — 6.5–7.1 SECONDS
BRIEF DESCENT INSERT

One short 0.6-second close tracking shot from ahead and slightly to the side. She is already descending fast, elbows bent, attention fixed down and forward toward the hidden landing point.

Ponytail streaming backward, skyline rising rapidly behind her, nose slightly below the horizon. Preserve forward momentum.

Cut out immediately: no held portrait. Keep the aircraft outside the frame.

SHOT 5 — 7.1–8.3 SECONDS
AIRCRAFT REVEAL AND RAPID CLOSURE

Hard cut wide: reveal the Red Bull cargo aircraft below and ahead, moving toward screen right in the same direction as the motorcycle.

The upper landing deck is immediately readable beneath her descending path. She is already approaching it, not suspended high above it while waiting for the plane.

The vertical gap closes visibly throughout this 1.2-second shot. Their forward velocities are similar for alignment, but the city still sweeps rapidly past both.

Match their travel direction and preserve their relative scale.

Only during the final approach does she bring the bike nearly level with the deck. End with the tires just above its rear portion. Carry the descent directly through the next cut.

SHOT 6 — 8.3–10.0 SECONDS
FIRM LANDING AND STOP

Cut beside the aircraft, showing the whole bike and deck. Rear tire touches by 8.6 seconds, front immediately after. No hover.

Contact compresses the suspension; elbows and knees absorb it. One controlled rebound. Roll forward, then brake: deck seams pass under the wheels and slow, while the city keeps sweeping past.

By 10.0 the bike is stopped on the deck. MILA plants both boots, holding it upright between her legs as the plane flies level. No sideways skid or slowed footage.

SHOT 7 — 10.0–14.0 SECONDS
OPEN, SIP, CELEBRATE

Close-medium three-quarter front view: show face, torso, hands and cockpit holder. The stopped bike stays supported by her planted boots.

10.0–11.3: she takes the closed can in her LEFT hand. Her RIGHT fingers lift its ring tab and visibly open it: metallic click, short hiss.

11.3–12.3: raise the OPEN can, mouth meeting the rim, and take one short sip. Never drink before opening.

12.3–12.8: lower the can below her chin and swallow.

12.8–14.0: grin, raise her free RIGHT fist and shout a loud, joyful American-English "YEAH!" Keep her mouth visible with matching lip movement, can upright in her LEFT hand.

Show these actions sequentially in one shot, not simultaneously. Wind moves her ponytail; preserve the deck and city behind her.

SHOT 8 — 14.0–15.0 SECONDS
FINAL WIDE REVEAL

Hard cut wide: the whole Red Bull aircraft, wings and rider above the daytime city. MILA sits on the stopped BMW, boots planted, can in her LEFT hand, smiling. The cheer may finish across the cut. No studio product shot or generated slogan.

AUDIO

Start immediately with a loud, believable high-rev motorcycle engine and rear-tire squeal. No silent lead-in.

At 0.15 seconds, the tire sound changes from stationary wheelspin to traction and hard acceleration. The engine rises immediately; no several-second revving introduction.

Use forceful passing air, increasing wind rush and continuous motorcycle sound through the jump and accelerating descent. Introduce aircraft engine sound at its reveal. Do not stretch the sounds into slow motion.

Synchronize the landing thud, tire contact and suspension compression. End the stunt with a controlled engine deceleration.

After stopping: tab click, opening hiss, sip, then "YEAH!" Clear synchronized voice above wind and aircraft sound. No other dialogue, narration, music or cartoon effects. Add any slogan separately.

CONTINUITY

Exactly one MILA, one BMW motorcycle, one aircraft and one Red Bull can. The closed can stays secured in its holder during the stunt; after stopping, she retrieves, opens and drinks from that same can before cheering.

Preserve MILA's face, high ponytail, extremely large full bust with pronounced forward projection, full rounded buttocks, narrow waist, lean limbs and exact outfit.

Preserve motorcycle geometry, BMW badges, Red Bull graphics and mechanical connections. Natural hands, fingers and limbs.

Timing priorities: already-developed burnout tail 0.00–0.15; release at 0.15, forward surge by 0.25; first cut at 0.60; takeoff near 3.1; uninterrupted full backflip through nose-UP, INVERTED, nose-DOWN, UPRIGHT by 4.7; accelerating descent; aircraft reveal 7.1; contact by 8.6; fully stopped by 10.0; retrieve and open, sip, lower and swallow, then "YEAH!"; final wide at 14.0.

No magic wings on the motorcycle, teleportation, midair stops, extra rotations, early aircraft reveal or cuts that omit the actual landing.

No subtitles, floating logos, interface, watermarks or editorial text. Physical Red Bull branding stays on the bike, aircraft and can; BMW badges stay on the bike.

High-Adrenaline Dark Fantasy — Cinematic Movie Trailer

[VISUAL STYLE LOCK]

Ultra-realistic, premium live-action, epic dark fantasy movie trailer.

Shot on ARRI Alexa XT with Camtec Vintage Ultra Prime lenses. 35mm Kodak film aesthetic.

Hazy, low-contrast cinematography. Muted earthy colors. Heavy analog film grain. Mild chromatic aberration. Slight lens vignette. Soft highlight bloom. Organic optical imperfections.

Indie-cinematic framing with large negative space, off-center compositions, naturalistic blocking, dramatic silhouettes and unusually deep environmental compositions.

Aggressive rack-focus transitions, handheld documentary-style camera movement, sudden whip-pans, imperfect crash zooms, violent camera vibration, rapid low-angle tracking shots, shaky shoulder-mounted combat photography.

Naturalistic lighting, practical fire, pale moonlight, thick atmospheric fog, volumetric smoke, heavy rain, blowing ash, realistic dust, layered focus and physical debris.

No glossy videogame rendering, cartoon physics, superhero aesthetics, modern tactical costumes, futuristic technology or polished digital magic.

MUSIC AND EDITING LOCK

Use @Video 1 as the exact musical track.

Create an EXTREMELY HIGH-ADRENALINE, HIGH-PACING cinematic trailer.

Cut tightly to the actual percussion, musical accents, instrumental transitions, rhythmic subdivisions and climactic impacts of the soundtrack.

Use violent hard cuts on heavy beats, rapid 3–6-shot montages during faster passages, and unexpected half-second moments of silence or visual stillness before the largest musical explosions.

Every important beat should correspond to a sword impact, bodily movement, explosion, camera transition, supernatural event or dramatic reveal.
